steps.title: Initialize Build Settings
steps.description: Configure compilation settings with SDK 34, AGP 8.3.2, and JDK 17 support in build.gradle.

steps.title: Declare Android Components
steps.description: Register MainActivity and the 9 specialized tool activities in the AndroidManifest file.

steps.title: Design Dashboard UI
steps.description: Construct a polished vertical grid UI in activity_main.xml with distinct launchers for all tools.

steps.title: Build Navigation Hub
steps.description: Develop MainActivity.java to bind and route launcher click actions to all activities.

steps.title: Build Calculator Activity
steps.description: Implement CalculatorActivity.java containing layout parameters and operation parsing logic.

steps.title: Build Stopwatch Activity
steps.description: Implement StopwatchActivity.java utilizing a Handler for high-precision millisecond timing.

steps.title: Build Note Keeper Activity
steps.description: Implement NotesActivity.java integrating dynamic note addition and local SharedPreferences persistence.

steps.title: Build Unit Converter Activity
steps.description: Implement UnitConverterActivity.java with multi-unit mathematical translations.

steps.title: Build Interactive Dice Roller
steps.description: Implement DiceRollerActivity.java with animation-interval calculations to simulate rolling.

steps.title: Build BMI Calculator
steps.description: Implement BmiCalculatorActivity.java providing real-time metric evaluations of height and weight.

steps.title: Build Color Mixer Activity
steps.description: Implement ColorPickerActivity.java combining RGB SeekBars and live color panel updates.

steps.title: Build Hardware Sensor Explorer
steps.description: Implement SensorExplorerActivity.java listing active hardware properties of the target mobile device.

steps.title: Build System Information Tool
steps.description: Implement AppInfoActivity.java reporting SDK versions, system specifications, and suite credits.

steps.title: Building Multi Utility Suite
steps.description: Run high-level verification and compile all 10 Java source files inside the build ecosystem.
